title: Edge Detection
oneLine: Find boundaries where image intensity changes sharply.

paras: Edges are where brightness changes fast - the outlines that carry most of an image's structure. Gradient operators like Sobel estimate that change; the Canny pipeline then thins the response and links strong, connected edges while suppressing noise. It is the front end of countless vision algorithms.
Edge strength is the gradient magnitude:
sections.texNote: Canny adds non-max suppression and hysteresis thresholding on top of this.

sections.code:
import numpy as np

Sx = np.array([[-1,0,1],[-2,0,2],[-1,0,1]])
Gx = conv2d(I, Sx); Gy = conv2d(I, Sx.T)
mag = np.hypot(Gx, Gy)            # edge strength
sections.caption: Sobel gradients give magnitude and direction.

takeaways: Edges are gradient maxima in intensity.
Sobel estimates the gradient; Canny refines it.
Edge maps front-end detection, matching, and segmentation.
